chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far عليه السلام say: Nothing that the fasting person does harms him, so long as he avoids three qualities: food, drink, women, and immersion.

key_terms.الصَّائِمَ: the person who is observing sawm (fasting)
key_terms.النِّسَاءَ: women; a reference to sexual relations
key_terms.ثَلَاثَ خِصَالٍ: three qualities or categories of acts

ai.seo_question: What things must a fasting person avoid according to Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning fasting, identifying the main acts from which the fasting person must abstain. It highlights eating, drinking, relations with women, and immersion as matters that invalidate or harm the fast in this context.
